name: Castleman Disease

prevalence.estimate: UCD: 15-19 per million; iMCD: 5 per million

criteria.description: Histopathological lymph node features consistent with Castleman disease (hyaline-vascular, plasmacytic, or mixed type)
Multicentric lymphadenopathy (>= 2 nodal stations for MCD)
Elevated CRP (>10 mg/L) or ESR (>15 mm/hr)
Anemia (Hb < 12.5 g/dL in men, < 11.5 in women)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: For iMCD: Both major criteria (histopathology + multicentricity) plus >= 2 of 11 minor criteria (6 laboratory + 5 clinical) from the full Fajgenbaum criteria. HHV-8 and other mimicking disorders must be excluded.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Three main forms: UCD (localized, usually curable by resection), HHV-8-associated MCD (HIV+ patients), and iMCD (IL-6 driven). TAFRO syndrome is a subtype of iMCD.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Lymphadenopathy (localized in UCD; generalized in MCD)
pathognomonic.notes: UCD: single enlarged lymph node station. MCD: multiple stations.

common.notes: More common in MCD; may be absent in UCD

rare.notes: TAFRO: Thrombocytopenia, Anasarca, Fever, Reticulin fibrosis, Organomegaly
Polyneuropathy, Organomegaly, Endocrinopathy, Monoclonal protein, Skin changes

laboratory: Elevated IL-6 (key cytokine driver in iMCD)
HHV-8 PCR/LANA immunostaining to classify (positive = HHV-8 MCD; negative = iMCD)
imaging: CT: localized lymphadenopathy (UCD) or generalized (MCD); may show hepatosplenomegaly, effusions
UCD: single large enhancing mass, often mediastinal or abdominal
genetic: Clonal cytogenetic abnormalities described in some UCD cases
other: Lymph node biopsy is essential: hyaline-vascular type (UCD), plasmacytic type (MCD), or mixed
Bone marrow biopsy: reticulin fibrosis (TAFRO subtype)
Exclude lymphoma, autoimmune diseases, and IgG4-related disease

distinguishingFeatures: Lymphoma has monoclonal lymphoid population on flow cytometry/biopsy
Lymphoma has specific histological subtypes (DLBCL, follicular, etc.)
Sarcoidosis has non-caseating granulomas on biopsy
Sarcoidosis has elevated ACE, bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy
IgG4-RD has elevated serum IgG4 and IgG4+ plasma cells on biopsy

redFlags: TAFRO syndrome (thrombocytopenia, anasarca, renal failure - can be rapidly fatal)
Rapid clinical deterioration with cytopenias and multiorgan failure
Development of lymphoma (especially in HHV-8 MCD)
references: Fajgenbaum DC, et al. International, evidence-based consensus diagnostic criteria for HHV-8-negative/idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease. Blood. 2017;129(12):1646-1657.
Dispenzieri A, Fajgenbaum DC. Overview of Castleman disease. Blood. 2020;135(16):1353-1364.
van Rhee F, et al. International, evidence-based consensus treatment guidelines for idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease. Blood. 2018;132(20):2115-2124.
